known.title: Follow-up: preserve literal matches for bracketed scope paths

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 2
Case: normal use - a client lists a dynamic-route file such as `app/orders/[id]/page.tsx` explicitly in Scope. The removed `_within` helper accepted `path == entry`; this replacement does not. `fnmatch` interprets `[id]` as a character class, so the identical literal path fails to match and appears under “Files the branch changes outside that scope.” Preserve the equality check when inlining the helper so explicitly permitted files remain classified correctly.
